description: This file contains unit tests for the Rialto server media pipeline callback, verifying forwarding of playback state, position, network state, media data requests, QoS notifications, and cache clearing functionality.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaPipelineCallbackTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the media pipeline callback, inheriting from MediaPipelineTestBase, with setup and teardown for media pipeline and GST player, and helper methods for simulating playback state.

methods.name: RialtoServerMediaPipelineCallbackTest
methods.description: Constructor that creates media pipeline and loads GST player.

methods.name: setPlaybackStatePlaying
methods.description: Sets playback state to playing and expects notification to the mock client.
